title: Moonhart Antler
html:
Monster drop: Moonhart

What it’s for

An enchant reagent. Each infuse (one carat more) of one of these uses one:

  • of Freezing (gems: Onyx + Topaz + Sapphire)
  • staff of Frost (gems: Amber + Sapphire + Sapphire)
  • of Mercy (gems: Diamond + Amber + Amber)

Dropped by Moonlit Beast: Glimmerfox, Pale Hart, Moonhart, White Unicorn, about 1 kill in 500 (an elite 1 in 50).

See Enchanter’s Table for the odds and fees, and Reagents for every reagent.
